about: What each vendored file in js/lib/ is (#27, 'Third-party code'): its package, version, license, where it came from, the SHA-256 of the file as committed, the license banner it carries (null when the upstream build has none), its THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES heading, and every local edit. An edit made here records the file's SHA-256 before it. js/lib/valibot/ has its own record, valibot/vendor.json. test/vendor.test.js checks every file against this record, and the build fails on a shipped js/lib file that differs from it or isn't in it.
